title: Even coefficients of a binomial polynomial
statement: For nonnegative integers $m$ and $j$ with $j\le m$, the coefficient of $t^{2j}$ in $\sum_{q=0}^{m}(-1)^q\binom{m}{q}t^{2q}$ is $(-1)^j\binom{m}{j}$.
